snippet.title: Official Grokit Purrtropolis Trailer!
snippet.description:
Releasing July 24! Grokit is a fast-paced, hand-tracking multiplayer mixed and virtual reality game built for quick, hilarious sessions with friends. Jump in, figure it out on the fly, and compete through a rapid-fire series of mini-games where every second counts!

Grokit's latest update brings a fresh batch of chaotic fun to your headset. Explore the futuristic city of Purrtropolis with new games, environments, and ways to play:

New Games
• Space Cat Trainer – Blast rogue mouse drones out of the sky
• Mouse Drone Racing – Race through tight turns and rings with repurposed drones

Check out the new environments - the neon streets of Meowtown and the Underwater Lab - and shake your game up with the new modifiers like Boosts, Shields, and more! PLUS, we added quests and daily achievements! What's not to love?

And if that's not enough, the new Style Deck is your room-scale playground dressing room. Invite your friends over, in person or virtually. Dress up with new hats, heads, and outfits, throw confetti and set off fireworks, and get some selfies!

#Grokit #VRGame #Purrtropolis #MetaQuest
